print_errors.note: Heading: shadda+kasra printed on the sad (shadda sits over the sad's tooth), no shadda on the dal (expected الصِّدِّيقيّة).
No fatha on the sad of صلِّ.

The marks over لمو form one merged cluster; component analysis at 1600-2400 dpi shows it is identical in shape and ink area to the cluster on الْمُمْكِنَةُ (p.059 line 1) = sukun on lam + damma on mim, plus a separate sukun on the waw. So the print has damma on the mim and sukun on the waw (expected الْمَوْصُوفَةُ). Contrast الْمَوْسُوطُ (p.060) and الْمَمْدُودِ (p.058), whose clusters are sukun+fatha.
A fatha is printed over the alif (hamzat wasl) after the waw.
Fatha printed over the lam stroke of the lam-alif, none over the hamza; sukun on nun. Compare الْأَسْرَارُ on the same page (sukun over lam, fatha over hamza).
Three separate kasras under dal, ya and final ha (an extra kasra under the ya).
Spacing kept as printed: space before the dash, none after (cf. [المائدة: ١٥ - ١٦] with spaces on both sides).
Only a fatha on the lam-alif of إِلَا, no shadda (expected إِلَّا).
Shadda+kasra printed on the mim (expected مِنْكَ); the later مِنْكَ in the same paragraph has a plain kasra.
Quran 4:80: the print has a damma on the ha of ٱللَّهُ (Tanzil ٱللَّهَ) and no waqf sign ۖ. Kept as printed; quran.py flags it.
No space printed between the comma and the opening ornate bracket; kept glued.

notes: p.057 continues p.056's last sentence ('وَأَعْظِم لِي نُورًا،' then 'وَأَعْطِنِي نُورًا'), so it gets '+'; p.059 and p.060 also continue mid-sentence ('+'); p.058 starts the new section (# heading per STRUCTURE). No footnote continues across pages. Bold: the phrases in bold type (parenthesised Mashishiyya text) are wrapped as (**…**) and «**…**», with the parentheses and quotes outside the markers. This follows keyA b17 for this section, and the quote marks visibly use the light weight. On p.059 only (وَتَنَزَّلَتْ عُلُومُ آدَمَ) is bold; the other parenthesised phrases there are set in the regular weight and are not marked. The line «(تُقْرَأُ مَرَّة يوميًّا …)» under the heading is printed bold but is written as a plain paragraph per STRUCTURE §2. In 'ب«كُنْتُ' the tatweel after the ba is dropped. The name الله with a printed case vowel but with the font's automatic shadda/alif ligature is written بِاللهِ / اللهُ, as in keyA b14. Quran: dagger alif written directly after the letter; the round silent-alif sign (shape checked against the khaa-head sukun) is ۟ in ظَّلَمُوٓا۟ / فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوا۟ / لَوَجَدُوا۟; the waqf ۚ after تَعْلَمُ is written with a space; فَٱتَّبِعُونِى ends in a dotless ى as printed. Many overlapping marks over 'الْمـ' clusters were resolved by connected-component analysis of 1600-2400 dpi renders: regular-font sukun+fatha (الْمَمْدُودِ، الْمَلَكُوتِ، الْجَبَرُوتِ، الْمَوْسُوطُ); sukun+damma (الْمُمْكِنَةُ، الْمُتَلَأْلِئَةِ (+ta fatha merged in)، الْمُزَكَّى (+zay fatha merged in)، الْمُؤَيَّدُ، الْمُوْصُوفَةُ). In the bold font, sukun is a circle, and the 'hat' shape (circle crossed by a fatha) = sukun+fatha (وَالْجَسَدِ، الْحَقَائِقُ، الْجَامِعُ). Words whose lam/mim carries only a damma with an open loop are written without a sukun on the lam (المُتَوَّجِ، المُودَعَةُ، المُشِعَّةُ). validate.py prints OK with one warning: on p.059 the footnote ref (١) is glued after the closing ﴾ ('(١١٣)﴾(١)'), as printed, and the validator does not count it.
